_comment: Colours for FIA WEC's past champion teams and makes that no team racing today colours, read by the Champions page (O34, lib/wp/endurance.ts) after the season's own cars and today's roster. Keys are the slugified name as champions.json writes it, without a trailing bracket (lib/slug.ts). A colour is taken only from a team or a make Paddock already colours today, named in `note` (the operator's answer P2, 18 Nov 2026); a name with no such match stays grey. `note` is ignored by code.

porsche-team.note: Porsche Penske Motorsport's colour in Paddock's IMSA list (content/series/imsa/drivers.json); 2015 to 2017.

porsche-penske-motorsport.note: The same team's colour in Paddock's IMSA list; 2024.

porsche.note: The make, as Porsche Penske Motorsport; the manufacturers' titles of 2015 to 2017.

audi-sport-team-joest.note: Audi's colour in Paddock's Formula 1 list (content/series/f1/drivers.json); 2012 and 2013.

audi.note: The make, as in Paddock's Formula 1 list; the manufacturers' titles of 2012 and 2013.
